text: 财政部数据显示，1—8月，全国一般公共预算收入156633亿元，同比增长5.7%。其中，证券交易印花税2160亿元，同比增长82%。1—8月，全国一般公共预算支出181451亿元，同比增长1.2%。
text_en: Ministry of Finance data show that from January to August, national general public budget revenue was 15.6633 trillion yuan, up 5.7% year on year. Among this, stamp tax on securities transactions was 216 billion yuan, up 82% year on year. From January to August, national general public budget expenditure was 18.1451 trillion yuan, up 1.2% year on year.
